newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico pension fund firms set up association.
newsitem.headline: Mexico pension fund firms set up association.

text.p: Companies that plan to enter Mexico's newly privatized pension fund system have set up their own industry association.
Manuel Reynaud, the head of Afore Santander-Mexicano, has been tapped as head of the Mexican Pension Fund Association, the companies said in a joint news conference on Monday.

Some 12 companies have been given authorization to begin operating the funds, known here as Afores, on July 1. The private system will replace the former state-run system that is virtually bankrupt. Officials hope it will increase domestic savings.
